info.title: Silver Falls Freeze Fix
info.author: Kaito-san
info.details:
DISCLAIMER: Made with Grok AI.

Restarts the Wii U when a Silver Falls game freezes. It is designed to accompany HaltFix.

Silver Falls games do not crash like a traditional Wii U game (PPCHalt); instead, they cease all video refreshing, but keep the audio moving. Since it is technically not PPCHalt, HaltFix fails to trigger, forcing you to have to force shutdown the console. This plugin aims to do what HaltFix fails to do for the following titles:
Silver Falls: White Inside Its Umbra
Silver Falls: Undertakers
Silver Falls: Ghoul Busters (the officially unreleased WUP)

When a Silver Falls game freezes, Silver Falls Freeze Fix detects it, intercepts it, displays a message, then cleanly restarts the console to save you of the hassle of having to hold down the power button even with HaltFix installed.
